Published in *BMJ Open*. [doi:10.1136/bmjopen-2020-042002](https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjopen-2020-042002)

Population-level observational evidence, drawn from social networking services, on the regional impact of Japan's COVID-19 state of emergency.
